notes: *no man* gives the determiner to `לֹא`, the negation the ASV has recast onto the subject nominal, leaving `אָדָם` its bare *man* (rule 15).
*that same* is placed whole on `הוּא`; the three articles of `הָאִישׁ הַמִּסְכֵּן הַהוּא` are `unrepresented` because the ASV writes no *the* for the phrase (rules 41, 47).
